chunks: Ahmad, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Al-Ḥasan ibn Al-Jahm, who said:

I was seated with Abū Al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, and he called for his son عليه السلام while he was small. He seated him in my lap and said to me: “Undress him and remove his shirt.” So I removed it, and he said to me: “Look between his shoulders.” So I looked, and there was on one of his shoulders something resembling a seal, embedded in the flesh. Then he said: “Do you see this? The like of it was in this place on my father عليه السلام.”

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, referring to the previous Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abū Al-Ḥasan, the Imam عليه السلام mentioned in the report
key_terms.ابْنِهِ: his son, the young child brought before the narrator
key_terms.اللَّحْمِ: the flesh, indicating the mark was embedded within it
key_terms.الْمَوْضِعِ: the location or place of the mark
key_terms.حِجْرِي: my lap, where the child was seated
key_terms.كَتِفَيْهِ: his two shoulders, the place that was examined

ai.seo_question: What sign was observed on the shoulder of the son of Abū Al-Ḥasan عليه السلام in al-Kāfī?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates a physical sign observed on the young son of Abū Al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, described as resembling a seal on his shoulder. The report serves as a biographical and theological indication connected to the recognition of the Imam and its continuity from his father عليه السلام.

en.hubeali: Ahmad, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Al Hassan Bin Al Jahm who said,

‘I was seated with Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> called for his<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> was small, so he<sup>asws</sup> seated him<sup>asws</sup> in his<sup>asws</sup> lap, and he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Disrobe him<sup>asws</sup> by removing his<sup>asws</sup> shirt’. So I removed it, and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Look between his<sup>asws</sup> two shoulders’. So I looked and there was in one of his<sup>asws</sup> shoulder, resembling a seal entered into the flesh. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do you see this?’ The like of it was in this place from my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ahmad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali From al-Hassan ibn al-Jahm who has said the following.

“Once I was in the presence of abu al-Hassan (a.s.). He called his son who was a small (boy). The Imams (a.s.) placed him in my lap and said to me. “ Move his shirt aside.” When I did so. The Imams (a.s.) said, “Look in between his shoulders.” I look and I found in the skin of one shoulder something like an imprint of a seal.” The Imams (a.s.) then asked, “Do you see this.? Similar to this there was one in the shoulder of my father.”
